content.text:
Created three files:

- `src/main/java/org/traccar/protocol/R16hProtocol.java` — UDP `EndpointListener` (datagram flag `true`) with `GlyphBoundaryFrameSplitter(MAX_FRAME_LENGTH, "$")`, string codecs, and the decoder.
- `src/main/java/org/traccar/protocol/R16hProtocolDecoder.java` — `AbstractWireDecoder` with two `GrammarComposer` patterns: `@LINK` (session only, returns null) and `@GPSD` (time, `WHOLE_DEG_HEMI` coordinates, speed via `nauticalFromMetricSpeed`, course, altitude, `KEY_BATTERY_LEVEL`, `KEY_LOCK`, `KEY_BACKLOG` for stored records, and `KEY_ALARM` from the trailing code when present).
- `src/test/java/org/traccar/protocol/R16hProtocolDecoderTest.java` — `WireDecoderHarness` test covering the login (`assertNoOutput`), the sample fix, plus stored-record, alarm, and unlocked-strap attribute cases.

Two notes:
- I could not compile or run the test: `./gradlew test ...` required approval and was auto-denied in this session, so the code is unverified by build.
- The alarm codes aren't specified beyond "short text code", so `decodeAlarm` maps a small set (`SOS`, `LB`, `RM`, `MV`, `GF`) and returns null otherwise; adjust once the real code table is known.
